items.title: Sheaves on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme are filtered colimits of constructible sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that on a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme every sheaf of sets, every torsion abelian sheaf and every sheaf of modules over a Noetherian ring is a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves (statement lines 12215-12229). The proof treats the three parts separately: the case of sheaves of sets uses the approximation by restrictions to quasi-compact and quasi-separated objects (proof lines 12231-12248), the module case uses the approximation by finite type sheaves (proof lines 12251-12266), and the torsion abelian case is reduced to the bounded torsion situation through the n-torsion filtration (proof lines 12269-12273). The non-formal content is the choice of the approximating systems. The claim is H2: three approximations, each written out.
